bio.text: Michael Bahry announced in June 2026 that he was gathering the 1,000 signatures needed to appear on the ballot as an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Rhode Island, the seat held by Democratic Sen. Jack Reed.
He is a visiting lecturer at Salve Regina University, where he has taught theology for three years, and is a former construction executive. He lives in East Providence.
According to his campaign, he began his career as a laborer and carpenter, earned a bachelor's degree from Providence College, and completed two graduate degrees in theological and biblical studies.
His campaign also says he founded the Providence nonprofit Fifty-Three: Five in 2014.

sources.title: Salve Regina lecturer Michael Bahry launches independent U.S. Senate bid
